comment: TINA simulation drawing with no designators: Sallen-Key low-pass and high-pass stages summed by a third LF351 to form a notch, run from two 9V batteries (+/-9V). The VG1 generator and Rload are simulation parts and are skipped.
rows: op-amp gain resistors, low-pass and high-pass stages
two to ground at the filter stages, one feedback in the mixer
two in the low-pass stage, one in the high-pass stage
second high-pass capacitor (the other is 10.0n as drawn)
wired as variable resistors, two per filter; probably ganged pairs to tune the notch
